data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name Aemilius. Aemilius is from the Latin word 'emulus', meaning rival or emulator. The name Emilianella is the feminine form, often used as a variation of Emilie. In Christian tradition, it carries the spiritual meaning of being a devoted and spiritual follower of Christ. The name Emilianella carries the meaning “Loving, Emilie's variant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emilianella usually hope their child will grow to embody loving, emilie's variant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In the Christian tradition, Emilianella is a name associated with the virtues of humility, compassion, and perseverance.
